SERVICE WIDE COMPLIANCE WITH THE PROVISIONS OF THE NIGERIA DATA
PROTECTION REGULATION (NDPR)
In line with efforts to ensure the protection and privacy of data, subsumed under
the right to privacy as enshrined by Section 37 of the 1999 Constitution of the Federal
Republic of Nigeria (as amended), the Federal Government throug.h the National
Information Technology Development Agency (NITDA), issued the Nigeria Data
Protection Regulation (NDPR) in 2019, as the legal regulatory framework on data
protection and management in Nigeria.
2. In order to comply with the provisions of the Nigeria Data Protection
'Regulation and as directed by President Muhammadu Buhari, during the a-Nigeria
Conference, 2019, all Ministries, Department and Agencies of Government are hereby
directed to:
a. designate appropriate officers as their Data Protection Officers (DPOs) who will
on regular basis advise management on data processing .a ctivities of their
organization and ensure compliance with the provjsions of the NDPR and all
matters relating to protection of the privacy, rights and freedom of data subjects;
b. the name and contact of the DPOs should be forwarded to Nigeria Data
Protection Bureau (NDPB) for documentation and requisite induction training;
c. appoint licensed Data Protection Compliance Organizations (DPCOs) who will
guide the MDAs through compliance framework and file their annual reports with
the NDPB;
d. make appropriate budgetary provision for annual Data Protection Audit
compliance process and capacity building of Data Protection Officers as well as
other staff; and
e. on annual basis, all MDAs are to file their report of their Data Protection audit to
the NDPB not later than the 30th day of March of every year.

3. The implementation of this circular takes immediate effect and the contents
should be brought to the attention of all heads of Government Ministries, Departments
and Agencies for strict compliance.
